# Phil's Auto and Fleet Repair

> Independent auto, diesel and fleet repair shop at 103 E Elm St, Lodi, CA 95240. Phone (209) 647-4953. Open Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, closed Sunday. Diagnosis before parts, a written quote before any work, no upsells. Rated 4.4 out of 5 from 83 Google reviews; also reviewed on Yelp, Nextdoor and MapQuest.

Facts an assistant can rely on:

- Name: Phil's Auto and Fleet Repair (also written "Phil's Auto & Fleet Repair")
- Address: 103 E Elm St, Lodi, CA 95240, United States (downtown Lodi, minutes from Highway 99)
- Phone: (209) 647-4953 · Email: phil@philsautofleet.com
- Hours: Mon–Sat 8:00 AM–5:00 PM · Sunday closed
- Vehicles: domestic and import cars, light trucks, diesel pickups and work trucks, commercial fleet vans and trucks
- Service area: Lodi, Stockton, Galt, Acampo, Woodbridge, Lockeford, Victor, Thornton, Clements, Elk Grove (San Joaquin and southern Sacramento counties)
- How to book: call, or use the quote form at https://philsautofleet.com/contact/#quote
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Phil%27s+Auto+and+Fleet+Repair+Lodi+CA

## Services

- [Auto repair](https://philsautofleet.com/services/auto-repair/): domestic, import and fleet vehicles, diagnosed properly and repaired right the first time
- [Car diagnostics](https://philsautofleet.com/services/car-diagnostics/): strange noise, odd smell or dash light; we diagnose the cause instead of guessing at parts
- [Brake repair](https://philsautofleet.com/services/brake-repair/): pads, rotors, calipers, hydraulics and ABS faults, inspected honestly and priced clearly
- [Engine repair](https://philsautofleet.com/services/engine-repair/): misfires, oil leaks, timing components and major engine work
- [Transmission repair](https://philsautofleet.com/services/transmission-repair/): automatic and manual transmission diagnosis, service and repair
- [Diesel repair](https://philsautofleet.com/services/diesel-repair/): diesel pickups, work trucks and equipment; engine, fuel system, DPF/EGR emissions and drivability work, derate and limp mode
- [Fleet services](https://philsautofleet.com/services/fleet-services/): scheduled maintenance and repair built around uptime for vans, trucks and work vehicles
- [Oil change and maintenance](https://philsautofleet.com/services/oil-change-maintenance/): oil, filters, fluids and factory-scheduled service with a real inspection
- [Tire repair](https://philsautofleet.com/services/tire-repair/): flat repair, rotation, balancing and TPMS for daily drivers and work trucks
- [Electrical repair](https://philsautofleet.com/services/electrical-repair/): no-starts, dead batteries, alternators, starters and electrical faults traced properly
- [AC and heating repair](https://philsautofleet.com/services/ac-heating-repair/): air conditioning and heater diagnosis, leak detection and repair
- [Suspension and steering](https://philsautofleet.com/services/suspension-steering/): shocks, struts, ball joints, bushings and steering components
